The [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]]<ref name="FF115" /> '''Mo/Dk power harpoon''' was a weapon located at the rear of the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it was used to great effect to bring down [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]].<ref name="SWCV" />
